notes.title: New AI, Bug Fixes and Live Service
notes.notes:
Ai -  A new type of enemy was added, check it out.
Music - Music ws added to improve vibes
Bug Fixes - Players can now spawn units flawlessly.

Live Service - As the developer I'm interested in turning the game into a Helldivers2 / Escape From Tarkov type of game. The option is to add a home region where you can upgrade your army, units and officer so there is a social place. there should also be a map / mission picking area where missions can be started to recieve xp and other rewards to level up your character. Disclaimer: I'm working on my other game Hardcore Survival but the live service layer could take from 1 to 2 weeks of active development.
